name: On-chain demand on a calm-tape breakout — tx_count cross-up + low realized-vol RSI breakout long
rationale: Thesis: a demand-backed breakout (RSI strength + tx_count cross_up) that occurs while realized volatility is LOW has more room to expand — the move starts from a coiled, low-vol base rather than chasing an already-blown-out tape. vol_realized is BOUNDED so a fitted ceiling binds (we require it BELOW a level = calm regime); RSI is BOUNDED so a strength floor binds; btc_tx_count drifts so it enters ONLY as a cross_up. Disconfirmer 1: drop the vol_realized<vol_ceil gate and keep tx_count cross + RSI breakout — if the deflated Sharpe holds, the low-vol filter is inert. Disconfirmer 2: drop the tx_count cross_up and keep RSI-breakout + low-vol — if the Sharpe holds, on-chain demand adds nothing. BTC/ETH/SOL/LINK, long-only spot.
catalyst: btc_tx_count crosses up while RSI shows strength and realized vol is in a calm band
